friedrich-alexander-universitat-erlangen.text: FAU states that non-EU applicants are charged a processing fee per application from winter semester 2026–27, and that some programmes will charge non-EU tuition from summer semester 2027. Check the programme, exemptions and current fee page before budgeting; do not assume all public-university courses are tuition-free.

memorial-university-of-newfoundland.text: Memorial’s international entrance scholarships are subject to available funding and eligibility. Eligible applicants are considered automatically, but selection is not guaranteed. These awards support the first year and are not renewable; transfer-credit limits also apply.

university-of-munster.text: Münster’s International Office provides an InfoPoint and advice for international students, including orientation and help finding the relevant university service. Use its student guidance page when planning arrival; researcher welcome services have a different audience.
